tasks.redPrompt:
Write the FAILING test suite for #264 stage 2. Contract: the PO RULING comment on mvox-app#264 (branch (i), 7 ratified points) + stage-1 report (comment 5558442685). Read BOTH via `gh issue view 264 --comments` before writing a spec. Platform facts (source-verified, in the stage-1 report): Entu POST entity/{id} is editor-gated for _parent (its rightTypes list excludes _parent); DELETE property/{id} is OWNER-gated for _parent; the native atomic overwrite — POST an array whose entry carries the OLD property value's `_id` alongside the new value fields — soft-deletes the old value in the SAME setEntity call, entirely under the editor gate (entu-www docs 'Overwriting a Property Value').

## 1. reparentSection goes atomic (src/lib/sections/sectionActions.ts:502-540 today)
New contract to pin: GET existing _parent value ids; if EXACTLY ONE → single POST `entity/{sectionId}` with body `[{ "_id": "<old value id>", "type": "_parent", "reference": "<newParentId>" }]` — no DELETE /property call anywhere in the reparent path (assert the fetch mock NEVER receives a property/{id} DELETE); if ZERO or MORE-THAN-ONE existing values → NO writes at all, throw a typed damaged-data error (see 4). Wire spec asserts the FULL POST body with toEqual. An editor-tier 403 half-landing becomes structurally impossible — pin that a rejected POST leaves exactly the old state (nothing landed is now TRUE when reported).
## 2. Truthful banners survive (the #253 two-copy model, both remaining failure modes)
(a) POST rejected outright → nothing landed → roster_section_reorder_failed is now HONEST — pin it; (b) reparent lands, renumber fails → roster_section_reparent_partial — the existing truthful pin at page.roster-indent.spec.ts:792-842 stays byte-valid; assert it still passes.
## 3. FLIP the lie-pinning specs (page.roster-indent.spec.ts:856-899)
The state-(a) test currently pins revert + 'nothing landed' copy for an error shape that USED to be a possible half-landing. Rewrite the pins to the new atomic contract: a rejected reparent means nothing landed (revert is now truthful), and the inner half-landing shape no longer exists to lie about. Also update src/lib/sections/sectionActions.partial.spec.ts:212-251 — the 'old-parent DELETE fails after POST landed' scenario is DELETED as impossible (do not keep a spec for an unreachable path; replace with the ≠1-values damaged-data specs).
## 4. Fail-loud duplicate parents (ruling item 5 — #258 fail-open class)
sectionData.ts:112's `.find()` silently picks a parent when a section holds ≠1 _parent values. New pinned behavior: the tree builder detects ≠1 _parent values on any section and surfaces DAMAGED DATA loudly — the affected section renders with an explicit damaged-state marker/message (new i18n keys, 4 locales), never a silent guess; the rest of the roster still renders. Exact surface shape is engineering's — propose in delivery report — but pin: (i) detection fires on both zero and 2+ values, (ii) no arrange affordances on a damaged node, (iii) the damaged marker names the section. Deterministic fixture: hand a listSections response with two _parent values for one section.
## 5. Clear-then-set family goes atomic (ruling item 3 — IN scope)
flipMemberStatus (src/lib/roster/memberLifecycle.ts:73-107), updateRsvpStatus (src/lib/rsvp/rsvpData.ts:154-213), updateAttendanceStatus (attendanceData.ts) currently DELETE-old-THEN-POST-new: a half-landing leaves the property EMPTY (worse than a duplicate). Convert each to the atomic overwrite (single POST with old value _id when a value exists; plain POST when none). Pin per function: full POST body shape, NO property/{id} DELETE issued, empty-property half-landing impossible (a rejected POST leaves the OLD value intact — pin with a deterministic rejected-fetch spec). Status props are not rightTypes, so no rights dimension — this is pure atomicity.
## 6. Audit-convert the remaining GET→POST→DELETE family where mechanical
src/lib/entu/replaceProperty.ts (shared helper — convert it; all its callers inherit atomicity), sectionActions.ts reorderSections (:339-384) + renameSection, repertoireActions.ts updateRepertoireStatus/pinEdition/updateProgramItemOrdinal. Pin the helper's new wire shape once (full body toEqual) + one representative caller spec per file proving no DELETE round-trip remains. If any site turns out NON-mechanical (multi-value semantics the overwrite can't express), leave it as-is and record it as a finding in your result summary instead of half-converting.
## 7. Generation-guard gap (ruling item 4 — the #259/#260 class)
performReorder (roster/+page.svelte:1530+) and performReparent (:1658+) check routeLoad.generation only on failure/refetch branches, never on success. Pin: a success response settling AFTER a collective switch must not write status/banner/tree state for the stale collective. DETERMINISTICALLY ORDERED race specs per the house method — test-held deferreds on the async boundary only, switch collective, then settle; the real assertion trips, never a timeout; pre-fix failure output reported verbatim.
## 8. Item-6 fold-in (PO nod on the issue 2026-09-06 13:03, with rider)
createSection (sectionActions.ts:148-153) adds explicit `{ type: '_inheritrights', boolean: true }` to its create body — asserts the platform-bootstrap dependency the item-6 audit found (matches inviteData.ts:286-290 member-create practice; no live behavior change). RIDER (mandatory): a spec pin asserting the explicit flag in the section-create POST body — full-shape toEqual on the create payload — with a spec comment naming WHY (absent ≡ false at aggregate time; create-time auto-fill only rescues when a _parent target is already true), so the one-liner cannot be 'simplified' away later.
## 9. Invariants
No gating change (adminStore predicate untouched — ruling item 7); no schema/type changes; no rights writes beyond the item-6 create-body assertion above; roster page's existing specs for unrelated behavior stay green. New i18n keys in all four locale files with 4-locale exact-text pins.

Drift check every cited line against HEAD. All new/changed specs must FAIL against current main — run and REPORT the failing output verbatim; a pre-passing spec is a defect. Stage explicitly by path.
